    15	  exact ProbabilityTheory.centralMoment_two_eq_variance hX.aemeasurable

    17	/-- Uncorrelatedness in the textbook's product-expectation sense makes the

    20	theorem integral_centered_mul_eq_zero_of_uncorrelated

    22	    {X Y : Ω → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 2 P) (hY : MemLp Y 2 P)
